title: Home guide: how far can sound travel?
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: States of matter (Marvellous Medicine and How Far Can Sound Travel?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 14 (Home practical guide and safety card: how far can sound travel (portal worksheet; no music, keep sounds gentle))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how sound changes as you move away from it.
equipment: A metal spoon and a cup, or a ticking kitchen timer
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: An adult taps the spoon on the cup, the same strength each time.
Walk away one step at a time.
Count your steps until you cannot hear it.
Try again with a door between you.

head: Test
Steps until I could not hear it
